name: Mind Sweeper Zettai Ryouki Shinpan
original_name: マインドスイーパー ～絶体凌域侵犯～
source: A young agent who has become the target of “The Organization,” the shadowy masters behind over‑tech crime, is pursued by a web of deadly traps set by the mad scientist Dr. Succubus.  From the “Plague Invade” series comes the return of the experiment subject El—again.
translation: 一名年轻特工成为了“组织”（过度科技犯罪背后的神秘大师）的目标，并被疯狂科学家魅魔博士设置的致命陷阱网所追捕。《瘟疫入侵》系列中，实验对象艾尔再次回归。
